function.description: Raise a DURABLE owner ask that HOLDS specific goals (blocks_goal_ids) until the owner answers. For any other owner decision use owner_ask — it tells the owner, offers taps and hands the answer to this rail's next run. Lands on the board, shows in /status, /pending and the daily digest; dedups against your OPEN asks, so call it every time you skip on the same blocker.
function.name: goal_ask

parameters.description: A durable OWNER-FACING need: "I require a decision/resource from you to proceed".

blocks_goal_ids.description: Goal ids this ask blocks (they are HELD until the owner answers, then re-armed).

what.description: The decision or resource you need from the owner, as ONE question they can answer in a word or two (name the options: 'A) … or B) …'). This lands on the durable board, shows in /status, /pending and the daily digest, and is deduplicated: a matching OPEN ask is refreshed, never duplicated — so raise it EVERY time you skip on it; never fall back to 'I asked once, I will not spam'.

why.description: Evidence: what is blocked, since when, what you tried, the numbers. Written for a phone.
